verdict.rationale: Motion documents native recurring task creation (daily/weekly/monthly/quarterly) that auto-blocks calendar time, plus an API for creating/managing tasks and an 'AI Workflow Builder' that builds workflows from SOPs, giving AI-native users building blocks for recurring automation. However there is no direct evidence of API-level recurring job scheduling, cron-like triggers, or cookbook examples specifically for automating recurring workflows programmatically. Missing for 10: API-documented recurring/cron scheduling endpoints, cookbook example of automating recurring workflows, independent confirmation of workflow builder reliability.
